All 4 are count-mismatch assertions on Backfill.run/1's {updated, skipped} tallies -- the signature of cross-test DB-state pollution (BackfillTest uses `async: false` with Sandbox :auto / real schema creation per its own moduledoc, so it sees any tenant rows other tests left committed), not a logic defect newly introduced. lint_handoffs's own scripts/test_parallel.sh run (my prior step-05 run and TEST-RUNNER's step-04c run) was fully green at 2089/2094, 0 failures -- the partitioned mechanism does not exhibit this; only the full serial `mix test` invoked by mix letflow.check does, which itself is evidence of an ordering/pollution mechanism rather than a real regression.
